column1: #use-interpreter -> enable it to use custom ui by utilising .slint files
# kill-apps -> enable or disable automatic termination of applications when daily limits are exceeded
# kill-cooldown -> minimum time interval (in milliseconds) between sequential application terminations
# poll-interval -> window focus check frequency (in milliseconds)
# db-flush-interval -> how often window tracking totals are saved to disk (in milliseconds)
# extension-shutdown-timeout -> wait time (in milliseconds) for Lua extensions to finish onExit before force exiting
# extension-reload-timeout -> wait time (in milliseconds) for Lua extensions to finish on reload/unload before detaching
# ui-update-interval -> tracking loop polling and UI update frequency (in milliseconds)
# ui-insight-interval -> interval to run the pattern analyzer and update insights on the UI (in milliseconds)
# ui-error-duration -> duration for which active errors are displayed on the UI (in milliseconds)
